verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents OHID sign-in, filing guides, tax tools, on-demand courses and in-person Welcome Center help, but nothing about an in-product AI assistant that can take delegated tasks. Human or in-person assistance is an adjacent feature and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
